headline: Over 350 neighborhood businesses lost in six years in Maremma. Nearly 100 in Grosseto. 54 million eaten up by online
summary: Maremma has lost 364 neighbourhood businesses in six years, nearly 100 of them in Grosseto. Confesercenti estimates 54.6 million euros of spending has shifted to online sales.
why: Shifts from local retail to e-commerce affect small-business survival, commercial property values and local tax bases.

original_headline: Oltre 350 imprese di vicinato perse in sei anni in Maremma. Quasi 100 a Grosseto. 54milioni mangiati dall'online
